title: Size bound after gate unfolding
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $g$ be a well-formed gate, and let $t$ assign a Boolean circuit on $n$ variables to each gate argument and polarity. Suppose that $g$ has at most $k$ arguments and every circuit $t(a,q)$ assigned to an argument of $g$ has size at most $B$. Then, for each polarity $p$, unfolding $g$ using $t$ gives a circuit of size at most $1+kB$.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ is well formed: its argument list has no repetitions and, if it is a NOT gate, has length one
The gate has at most $k$ arguments
Every circuit assigned to an argument of $g$ at either polarity has size at most $B
